title: TheRealFlow
description: TheRealFlow: where developers and buyers meet. Developers want to sell faster. Buyers want certainty before they sign. This podcast sits right in the middle. Every episode, Mario breaks down one piece of how new construction real estate really works: how presales are priced, why developers need early buyers, how investors profit before a building is finished, and what turns a rendering into a signed contract. Twenty years of real projects, explained plainly. New episodes every weekday.
